scope: Read-only installed-source and compiled-library investigation. No serial device opened; no code or hardware modified by this inspection.

confirmed_findings.finding: Espressif Newlib defaults to a 128-byte stdio buffer.
confirmed_findings.evidence: sys/config.h unconditionally defines __BUFSIZ__ as 128 in its Espressif section. stdio.h maps BUFSIZ to that value. Compiled __swhatbuf_r selects 128 when st_blksize is zero.

confirmed_findings.finding: The installed FatFS VFS reports a zero preferred block size.
The installed fread always refills its FILE buffer instead of bypassing it for large requests.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Compiled _fread_r repeatedly copies buffered bytes and calls __srefill_r. Compiled __srefill_r invokes the underlying read callback with the FILE buffer size.

confirmed_findings.finding: Each FatFS f_read call validates storage status.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Compiled f_read calls validate first. Compiled validate calls ff_disk_status. Arduino ff_sd_status acquires SPI and sends CMD13.

confirmed_findings.finding: The Arduino FS wrapper explicitly supplies 4096-byte buffering.
confirmed_findings.evidence: vfs_api.cpp defines DEFAULT_FILE_BUFFER_SIZE as 4096. Its constructor calls setvbuf when st_blksize is zero. A checked direct fopen adapter bypasses this wrapper behavior.

confirmed_findings.finding: Arduino SD supports multi-sector CMD18 reads, but a 128-byte FatFS request cannot enter that path.
confirmed_findings.evidence: ff_sd_read calls sdReadSectors when count exceeds one. sdReadSectors sends CMD18, receives 512-byte sectors, then sends CMD12. Compiled f_read requires at least one sector in its request before using a direct sector transfer.

confirmed_findings.finding: Arduino SPI receives payloads through a polled FIFO, without DMA.
confirmed_findings.evidence: SPIClass::transferBytes calls spiTransferBytesNL inside a transaction. The latter transfers at most 64 bytes through the FIFO, busy-waits for spi->dev->cmd.usr, and copies FIFO words to the output. It creates no DMA descriptors.

confirmed_findings.finding: The Arduino SD driver caps higher requested frequencies.
confirmed_findings.evidence: sd_diskio.cpp clamps card frequency to 25 MHz. The actual classic ESP32 divider and resulting bus rate require the separate hardware measurements.

calculated_implications.caveat: Counts are ideal buffer-refill calculations. Runtime counters, request alignment, cache state and filesystem boundaries determine actual count.

recommended_measurement_order: Compare 128, 4096 and 8192-byte buffering on rb handles using the same file, clock and offset. Verify size/CRC and inspect the actual FILE buffer size.
Compare direct POSIX read/lseek on a dedicated descriptor for the bulk baseline. Never mix descriptor offsets with buffered stdio on the same handle.
Count underlying VFS read request sizes, ff_sd_status calls, and ff_sd_read requests for one sector versus multiple sectors.
Measure command time separately for CMD13, CMD17, CMD18 and CMD12; then token wait time and poll count, 512-byte payload transfer, CRC16, and retries.
Use the read-only contiguous-file check to separate fragmentation from driver overhead.

alternative_driver.preferred_candidate: Existing ESP-IDF SDSPI plus FatFS before adding SdFat.
alternative_driver.interface: esp_vfs_fat_sdspi_mount and spi_bus_initialize on SPI3_HOST (VSPI), using SCK18, MOSI23, MISO19 and CS5; TFT remains on SPI2_HOST (HSPI).
properties: Uses the installed SDK driver and can enable DMA.
Retains the /sd stdio/POSIX paths and checked fsync behavior.
disk_status_check_enable defaults to false; compare true/false while preserving read-error and card-removal handling.

SD-specific metadata methods need an adapter. A generic fs::FS with VFSImpl bound to /sd can retain existing directory operations. Calling the global SD object after mounting only through IDF is insufficient.
Release SD and Arduino SPI ownership before initializing the IDF bus; clean up every mount/unmount failure. Keep format_if_mount_failed false.
alternative_driver.second_candidate: A pinned SdFat driver with dedicated SPI and a direct file adapter, if measured results still justify the larger integration.

qualification: The compiled 128-byte default and call path are confirmed. The fraction of the measured 517/447 ms bulk-read and 31/27 ms playback-read times attributable to this behavior still requires a device benchmark.
